01 / Define targetsIllustrated scene

AI-generated illustration · intended targets

T1FRESH ORANGE JUICEC1 storefront sign
T2OPEN DAILYC2 window poster
Purpose

Give every intended text a stable identity.

The structured specification binds each target string to a particular carrier. The generation prompt and evaluation targets have distinct roles.

Input
Prompt + carrier / slot specification
Output
Carrier-grounded target slots

Target strings are persistent in this track, even when their carriers move.

02 / Observe framesIllustrated scene
P001FRESH ORANGE0.98
P002JU1CE0.94
P003FRESH ORANGE JUICE0.99
P004OPEN DAILY0.98
Purpose

Observe what is actually rendered.

Sample frames, run OCR, and retain eligible candidates. Each region has an ID, an observed string, confidence, and geometry. The string JU1CE stays exactly as observed.

Input
Sampled video frame at 0.5 s
Output
Numbered OCR candidates + marker image

OCR supplies the scored text. A high-confidence string can still be wrong or belong to another target.

03 / Ground carriersIllustrated scene
✓ C1 → storefront sign✓ C2 → window poster
Purpose

Identify the visual entity that owns the target.

Use scene context, position, and visual attachment to find the storefront sign. P003 is inside the window poster, so it cannot satisfy the sign’s target—even with identical text.

Input
Required carriers + numbered marker image
Output
Carrier presence + candidate ownership

04 / Select & groupIllustrated scene
T1 ← P001 + P002FRESH ORANGE JU1CE

Matched to the right target. The character error remains.

Why not P003?

Its characters match perfectly, but its visual carrier is C2 window poster. The target belongs to C1 storefront sign. P003 stays unassigned.

Purpose

Select the intended instance, including its errors.

Combine P001 and P002 in reading order for T1. Their layout and carrier establish correspondence. P003 is a textual match on the wrong carrier. The selected JU1CE is not repaired.

Input
Unresolved targets + marker image + carrier-constrained candidates
Output
Selected candidate IDs, then verbatim OCR concatenation

  "assembled_observation": {
    "slot_id": "T1",
    "selected_ids": [
      "P001",
      "P002"
    ],
    "pred_text": "FRESH ORANGE JU1CE"
  }
}

T2 → P004 resolves through the high-similarity fast path. Only unresolved T1 enters this VLM request; i = 0 is its request index.

05 / Follow targetsTarget timeline

AI-generated sampled frames · illustrative motion

Purpose

Compare the same target across active observations.

Match each frame independently, then group observations by stable target ID. A temporarily inactive carrier/reference is excluded. A missing match while active stays in the sequence and receives zero credit.

Input
Per-frame matches + carrier / reference activity
Output
Target-indexed sequences of active observations
View example data ↗

Simplified fields from this illustrative example.

{
  "slot_id": "T1",
  "observations": [
    {
      "timestamp": 0,
      "active": true,
      "pred_text": "FRESH ORANGE JUICE"
    },
    {
      "timestamp": 0.5,
      "active": true,
      "pred_text": "FRESH ORANGE JU1CE"
    },
    {
      "timestamp": 1,
      "active": false,
      "pred_text": ""
    },
    {
      "timestamp": 1.5,
      "active": true,
      "pred_text": "FRESH ORANGE JU1CE"
    }
  ]
}

Target IDs connect observations. OCR candidate IDs do not act as cross-frame tracking IDs.

Calculated over all four illustrative observations. P003 remains unassigned on each active frame.

Purpose

Measure correctness and consistency after matching.

Spatial compares each observation with its intended target. Temporal compares adjacent active observations with one another. Persistent misspellings can be temporally stable while remaining spatially wrong.

Input
Target strings + complete active observation sequences
Output
Spatial, Temporal, TextVScore + separate diagnostics
View example data ↗

Simplified fields from this illustrative example.

{
  "metrics": {
    "spatial_fidelity": 0.8833333333333334,
    "temporal_fidelity": 0.86,
    "textv_score": 87.151051625239,
    "extra_text_ratio": 0.4801219512195122
  },
  "scope": "All four illustrative frames; not a model benchmark result."
}

Video S and T use target-length weights: 16 characters for T1 and 9 for T2. The harmonic mean combines those video-level components.
